title: After switching audio devices using the radio buttons, sometimes both the old and new devices' buttons get stuck in a "selected" state
line: After unplugging the current audio device, the Audio Volume widget no longer ends up with two devices selected or a device that can't be picked.
explanation: When the default device disappeared, pulseaudio-qt announced the default change from the map's removed signal, which runs before the models finish removing the row (the Server connects first). The applet's radio buttons re-read their device through the proxy model in that window, got nothing for rows after the removed one, and their 'PulseObject?.default' bindings stopped tracking the device for good. Such a row then kept whatever state the user clicked it into, leaving two devices checked, and clicking it again did nothing because a checked radio button doesn't toggle. The server now clears a default device when its row is about to be removed, before the models start the removal, so views always see consistent rows.

commits.message:
server: drop a removed default device before its row goes away

Removing the default device announced the default change while models
were halfway through removing its row, so applet radio buttons could
lose track of their device and stay checked; clear it beforehand now.

BUG: 500968
